title: Write Document
description: Formats a title and structured section blocks into a finished Markdown document in the workspace.

input_schema.name: title
input_schema.description: Document title (also becomes `<title>.md`).

input_schema.name: sections
input_schema.description: Ordered Markdown section strings.

sample_prompts: Write a weekly status report covering shipped items and next week's priorities.
Compile our onboarding checklist into a clean workspace document.

title: Make Spreadsheet
description: Formats column headers and row cells with RFC-4180 CSV quoting into `<title>.csv` in the workspace.

input_schema.name: title
input_schema.description: Spreadsheet title (writes `<title>.csv`).

input_schema.name: columns
input_schema.description: Ordered header column names.

input_schema.name: rows
input_schema.description: 2D array of string cell values.

sample_prompts: Turn my Q4 software expenses into a clean CSV spreadsheet with Vendor, Category, and Cost columns.
Build a structured inventory CSV from the items listed in my notes.

title: Web Research
description: Fetches one or more web pages, records fetch status honestly per source, and compiles sourced notes into `Research - <topic>.md`.

input_schema.name: topic
input_schema.description: Research subject used in the heading and filename.

input_schema.name: urls
input_schema.description: List of HTTP(S) URLs to fetch and compile.

sample_prompts: Research vendor compliance documentation across these three URLs and compile sourced notes.
Fetch these release-note pages and save a single cited research summary.

title: Update Memory
description: Records a durable single-line preference or learned fact into the employee's standing `memory.md`.

input_schema.name: note
input_schema.description: Single-line preference or fact to append to standing memory.
input_schema.example: Always include currency totals rounded to two decimals.

sample_prompts: Remember that I prefer concise bullet summaries before detailed tables.
Record in standing memory that all finance exports use USD with two decimal places.

title: Reconcile Ledger
description: Reconciles one or more workspace CSV invoice/expense ledgers with penny-exact arithmetic, flagging duplicate references, missing receipts, and cross-file mismatches alongside vendor and category rollups.

input_schema.name: source_files
input_schema.description: One or more workspace-relative CSV ledger paths.

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Output title prefix for the Markdown report and summary CSV.

sample_prompts: Reconcile invoices.csv and expenses.csv, flag duplicate invoice numbers and missing receipts, and total spend by vendor and category.
Audit Q4-expenses.csv for missing receipts, duplicate references, and anomalous amounts.

title: Summarize Meeting
description: Extracts participants, line-cited decisions, action items with owners and due dates, open questions/risks, and ready-to-send team and per-owner follow-up drafts from meeting notes.

input_schema.name: notes_file
input_schema.description: Workspace-relative path to the meeting transcript or notes file.

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Title for the generated Markdown summary.

sample_prompts: Summarize standup-notes.md into decisions, action items with owners and due dates, and follow-up drafts.
Extract every commitment, owner, deadline, and open blocker from q4-planning-transcript.txt.

title: Audit Contract
description: Checks contracts and vendor agreements for required clauses, extracts renewal/term/notice dates, flags missing provisions, and emits a line-cited `[L##]` risk table with redline guidance.

input_schema.name: contract_file
input_schema.description: Workspace-relative path to the contract text or Markdown file.

input_schema.name: required_clauses
input_schema.description: Optional checklist of required clauses (uses standard 8-clause corporate checklist if omitted).

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Title for the generated contract audit report.

sample_prompts: Audit vendor-msa.md for auto-renewal traps, unlimited liability, missing confidentiality/data-protection clauses, and produce a line-cited risk table.
Review supplier-agreement.txt against termination, indemnification, payment, and governing law requirements.

title: Triage Inbox
description: Classifies messages, emails, or support tickets (Markdown, plain text, CSV, or JSON) into Urgent, Action, and FYI buckets with priority scores, rationale, and concrete next steps.

input_schema.name: inbox_file
input_schema.description: Workspace-relative path to inbox export (.md, .txt, .csv, or .json).

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Title for the generated triage report.

sample_prompts: Triage inbox.md into Urgent, Action, and FYI queues with concrete next steps for every item.
Prioritize support-tickets.csv so critical outages and overdue billing alerts float to the top.

title: Clean Dataset
description: Normalizes CSV or JSON schemas to lowercase snake_case, repairs ragged rows, standardizes null tokens, deduplicates rows, flags statistical outliers (|z| >= 2.5), and writes a clean CSV plus diff metrics report.

input_schema.name: input_file
input_schema.description: Workspace-relative path to the messy .csv or .json dataset.

input_schema.name: key_column
input_schema.description: Optional deduplication key column name (empty deduplicates by full normalized row).

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Title prefix for the cleaned CSV and diff metrics Markdown report.

sample_prompts: Clean raw-orders.csv: normalize headers, deduplicate on order_id, standardize N/A values, flag numeric outliers, and produce a diff report.
Normalize crm-export.json into a deduplicated snake_case CSV with a column-level null and outlier audit.

title: Compare Documents
description: Performs linear-time line-by-line diffing between two workspace files, reporting added/removed/unchanged counts, similarity %, heading changes, and unified `[L##]`/`[R##]` context hunks.

input_schema.name: left_file
input_schema.description: Baseline (before) workspace file path.

input_schema.name: right_file
input_schema.description: Revised (after) workspace file path.

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Title for the generated comparison report.

sample_prompts: Compare policy-v1.md against policy-v2.md and summarize every added, removed, or modified clause.
Diff contract-draft-1.txt and contract-draft-2.txt with line-numbered hunks.

title: Draft Brief
description: Drafts an executive memo or SOP grounded strictly in named workspace files and standing memory (`memory.md`), citing `[file:L##]` for every finding and halting if zero readable sources exist.

input_schema.name: topic
input_schema.description: Subject of the executive memo or SOP.

input_schema.name: source_files
input_schema.description: Workspace files to ground the brief in.

input_schema.name: audience
input_schema.description: Intended readers (e.g. Executive leadership, Finance ops).

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Optional output document title (defaults to `Brief - <topic>`).

sample_prompts: Draft an executive brief on Q4 Spend Controls grounded in reconciliation.md and meeting-notes.md using my standing preferences.
Turn ops-notes.md and audit.md into a cited SOP brief for the operations team.

title: Extract Tables
description: Parses unstructured Markdown pipe tables, key=value structured logs, TSV blocks, or Key: Value records from a workspace file into clean RFC-4180 CSV spreadsheets.

input_schema.name: source_file
input_schema.description: Workspace-relative path to Markdown, text, or log file.

input_schema.name: output_title
input_schema.description: Title prefix for extracted CSV spreadsheet(s).

sample_prompts: Extract the structured key=value records from service.log into a clean CSV spreadsheet.
Pull all Markdown tables out of quarterly-review.md into separate CSV files.
